overview.text: 早 means “morning” and “early.” One account interprets 日 above 甲 as the sun’s first appearance; a separate analysis proposes 日 plus a sound element in some later-bronze forms.

components.text: 日 depicts the sun in one account and contributes meaning in the other.
In one account, 甲 means “first,” suggesting the sun’s initial appearance.
A later-bronze analysis proposes 棗 as a sound element; its identity in a particular inscription is uncertain.
